# Dubai Fine Clean

> Professional cleaning company in Dubai, UAE, trading since 2016. Residential and villa deep cleaning, office and commercial contracts, post-construction cleaning, carpet/upholstery and marble care, AC duct and coil cleaning, water tank cleaning to Dubai Municipality standard, window and glass cleaning, and façade cleaning with certified rope access. Insured teams, eco-certified products, a fixed written quote before work starts, and a 24-hour re-clean guarantee.

- Office: Diamond Business Center 1 — Office 510, Al Barsha South Third, Al Barsha South, Dubai, UAE
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 56 916 9761 (https://wa.me/971569169761)
- Hours: 7 days a week, 8am – 10pm
- Coverage: Dubai, including Business Bay, Downtown, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah, Al Barsha, Dubai Hills, Arabian Ranches and more than 40 communities in total

## Service categories

- [Residential deep cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/residential): villas and apartments to a written checklist; move-in, move-out and weekly plans
- [Office & commercial cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/commercial): offices, retail, restaurants and warehouses, cleaned outside trading hours
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/construction): debris clearance, HEPA fine-dust extraction and a detail clean to handover standard
- [Carpet, upholstery & marble](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/surfaces): hot-water extraction for fabric; diamond honing and crystallisation for stone
- [AC duct & coil cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/air): negative-air extraction with before/after camera footage
- [Water tank cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/water): drained, scrubbed, disinfected and refilled to Dubai Municipality standard, with a compliance certificate
- [Window & glass cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/windows): purified-water poles, ladder and rope access; frames, tracks and sills included
- [Façade cleaning](https://dubaifineclean.com/services/facade): villa pressure washing and certified rope access for towers; permits and RAMS handled

## Key facts

- Typical apartment deep clean: 5–8 hours, 2–3 staff. Typical villa deep clean: 8–12 hours, 4–6 staff.
- Pricing: by property size, condition and scope; a fixed written quote is given before work starts and does not change on site.
- Guarantee: report an issue within 24 hours of handover and the area is re-cleaned at no cost.
- Products: eco-certified, non-toxic, low-residue; colour-coded cloths prevent cross-contamination.
